folderIndex.title: Indexes
folderIndex.description: Choose which folders get indexes. Agents can search each index type through its corresponding file index feature. Subfolders follow their parent unless you turn them off.
folderIndex.moreTypes: Each index type has its own column, tools and agent feature.
folderIndex.betaNote: Beta · may affect performance. This index runs a local model on every file, which is heavy: large folders can slow the browser and use a lot of memory, CPU/GPU and battery. Start with a small folder, and pause or slow it down in Indexes if needed.
folderIndex.noFolders: No folder has an index yet. Add one for the folder you are in above, or use the Indexes button or a folder's menu.
folderIndex.addHint: You can also add or remove an index with the Indexes button, a folder's menu, or Index on an open file.
folderIndex.skipHint: One per line. A pattern ending in / skips folders.
folderIndex.embeddingWorkHint: One indexing task runs at a time. Smaller batches and longer pauses reduce background load. Progress is saved; pause takes effect after the current embedding operation. Existing content stays searchable.
folderIndex.agentsMayAsk: Agents may ask to index a folder
folderIndex.noDirectFiles: No files directly in this folder
folderIndex.mappedBody: This folder is on your computer's disk. Indexing reads its files and keeps index data in Memorall; the folder itself is not changed. Agents with the corresponding file index feature can search that data.
